questions.question: A student finds the average of twenty 2-digit numbers. While copying numbers, by mistake, he writes one number with its digits interchanged. As a result of that his answer is 2.7 less than the correct answer. The difference of the digits of the number, in which he made mistake, is:
questions.questionHtml: A student finds the average of twenty 2-digit numbers. While copying numbers, by mistake, he writes one number with its digits interchanged. As a result of that his answer is 2.7 less than the correct answer. The difference of the digits of the number, in which he made mistake, is:
questions.solution:
=>Let the interchanged number be xy -> 10x + y

Difference in the number due to interchange = 10x +y – (10y+x) =

9(x-y) = 2.7 × 20

=> (x-y) = 6 (Ans)

∴ The difference of the digits of the number is 6.
